title: Normalized tensor comparison for one varying-ring inverse image
statement: Let R_n be arbitrary commutative rings with arbitrary transitions phi_n. For a scheme map f:X→Y use the canonical varying-ring module-system direct image [def-sp-varying-ring-operations]. Let G equal this direct image, F be an exact additive left adjoint to G, and adj be its specified adjunction. Let A and B be closed structures with their K-flat tensor models TA and TB on the actual Y- and X-system categories [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. Given lax tensor maps t for G with the usual local pure-tensor formula (transported by the specified equality G=push), there exist a derived tensor comparison mu and TensorComparisonModel for F,A,B,TA,TB whose ordinary comparison has adjunction transpose tensor(unit,unit) followed by t. This is a comparison for one fixed map and fixed ordinary adjunction, and supplies neither the ordinary operations nor open extension.

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 0G7E; sites-modules.tex Tag 03EL; Zheng Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10. Labels lemma-pullback-tensor-product and lemma-pullback-K-flat.

proof.text: On the vertical sequence sites, construct the set-sheaf inverse image using representable flatness of base change. Transport finite-product algebraic structures to obtain its actual ring and module inverse images. The given ring-sheaf map defines the structural coefficient morphism. Restrict the set-sheaf adjunction to linear maps and compose with scalar extension, retaining its underlying hom-equivalence formula. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies this constructed module pullback with F. Transport the normalized ordinary tensorator through this isomorphism. Test its transpose on the universal pure pairing; generalized pure-tensor normalization, the given formula for t and the sheaf tensor universal property prove the displayed equality.

Total the inverse ordinary tensorator on all bidegrees using the signed total-complex comparison, whose summand formula follows from the coproduct universal property. Ringed-topos pullback preserves K-flat complexes with flat terms; transport this through the natural isomorphism with F. Restrict TA to flat-term K-flat representatives and TB to all K-flat representatives. Fully faithful restriction to the source resolving representatives descends the total comparison to mu. Cancel the representative, localization and tensor isomorphisms in its defining square to obtain the derived field of TensorComparisonModel.

theorem tensorComparison_exists
    (R : ℕ → CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, R (n + 1) ⟶ R n)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (G : Modules R φ X ⥤ Modules R φ Y) (hG : G = push R φ f)
    (F : Modules R φ Y ⥤ Modules R φ X) (adj : F ⊣ G)
    [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (A : SemilinearSections.Closed.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y))
      (systemRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (coefficients R Y) (coefficientTransition R φ Y)))
    (B : SemilinearSections.Closed.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology X))
      (systemRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (coefficients R X) (coefficientTransition R φ X)))
    (TA : Models.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y))
      (systemRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (coefficients R Y) (coefficientTransition R φ Y)) A)
    (TB : Models.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology X))
      (systemRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (coefficients R X) (coefficientTransition R φ X)) B)
    (t : ∀ M N : Modules R φ X,
      ordinaryTensor.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y))
        (systemRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (coefficients R Y) (coefficientTransition R φ Y))
        (G.obj M) (G.obj N) ⟶
      G.obj (ordinaryTensor.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology X))
        (systemRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (coefficients R X) (coefficientTransition R φ X))
        M N))
    (ht : ∀ (M N : Modules R φ X) (V : (ℕ × Y.ProEt)ᵒᵖ)
      (x : (G.obj M).val.obj V) (y : (G.obj N).val.obj V),
      cast (congrArg
        (fun H : Modules R φ X ⥤ Modules R φ Y ↦
          ((H.obj (ordinaryTensor.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
            (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology X))
            (systemRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (coefficients R X)
              (coefficientTransition R φ X)) M N)).val.obj V : Type (u + 1))) hG)
      ((t M N).val.app V
        (tensorSection.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
          (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y))
          (systemRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (coefficients R Y)
            (coefficientTransition R φ Y))
          (G.obj M) (G.obj N) V x y)) =
      tensorSection.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology X))
        (systemRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (coefficients R X) (coefficientTransition R φ X))
        M N (((𝟭 ℕ).prod (Scheme.proEtaleBaseChange f)).op.obj V)
        (cast (congrArg (fun H : Modules R φ X ⥤ Modules R φ Y ↦
          ((H.obj M).val.obj V : Type (u + 1))) hG) x)
        (cast (congrArg (fun H : Modules R φ X ⥤ Modules R φ Y ↦
          ((H.obj N).val.obj V : Type (u + 1))) hG) y)) :
    ∃ mu : A.tensor ⋙ F.mapDerivedCategory ≅
        (F.mapDerivedCategory.prod F.mapDerivedCategory) ⋙ B.tensor,
      ∃ model : TensorComparisonModel.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y))
        (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology X))
        (systemRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (coefficients R Y) (coefficientTransition R φ Y))
        (systemRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (coefficients R X) (coefficientTransition R φ X))
        F A B TA TB mu,
        ∀ M N : Modules R φ Y,
          adj.homEquiv _ _ (model.ordinary M N).hom =
            ordinaryTensorHom.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
              (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y))
              (systemRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (coefficients R Y)
                (coefficientTransition R φ Y))
              (adj.unit.app M) (adj.unit.app N) ≫ t (F.obj M) (F.obj N)
